result.title: Onion Rice Bowl (양파덮밥)

evidences.text: Cooked rice is served in a bowl
A fried egg is placed on top of the rice bowl

steps.text: Add cooking oil to a pan and fry the sliced onion shortly.

evidences.text: fry shortly / 양파를 살짝 볶은 후
Pouring cooking oil and stirring sliced onions in the pan

steps.text: Add 1/2 tablespoon chilli pepper powder, 1/2 tablespoon sugar, and 2 tablespoons soy sauce.
Fry for about 1 minute to keep the texture without making the onion too soft, then turn off the heat.

evidences.text: fry for 1 minute / to keep texture / and stop heating / 양파가 많이 물러지지 않게 1분 정도 볶은 뒤 불을 끄고

steps.text: Add 1 tablespoon sesame oil and black pepper powder, then mix evenly.
Place cooked rice into a bowl and top with the cooked seasoned onion.

evidences.text: Scooping seasoned onions over a bowl of rice

steps.text: Top with a fried egg and optionally garnish with sesame seeds.

unresolved: Exact amount of black pepper powder
